title: Sword Master

outfit_card.silhouette: Layered wuxia-inspired ensemble with a fitted crossover jacket over a flowing pleated skirt and split side panels; asymmetric wrapped waist sash with long trailing ribbons; cape-like wide sleeves with inner sheer layers; elegant column silhouette with side slits and slight train.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Ornate silver filigree crown with blue enamel accents and dangling teardrop tassels, securing a high half-updo with a long, flowing black ribbon tail.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Crossover-collar silk jacket in gradient blue and white, featuring intricate silver thread embroidery of flowing water and clouds, fastened with a dark woven belt and a sculpted silver chest clasp; wide layered sleeves with sheer white organza inner cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: High-waisted pleated skirt with tiered ombre layers from deep teal to pale blue, embellished with silver scalloped embroidery at the hem; matching wide-leg undertrousers with lace trim; dark stockings and black leather pointed-toe flats.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A slender, elegant silver-hilted sword with a tassel; floating translucent sword-energy motifs and ink-wash cloud patterns; a small companion creature in a matching azure hat and cape.
